text_block_list.text:
The Droit season was approaching. It 
seemed last year's hit Fashion Check 
project was continuing, and North Flight 
was full of enthusiasm, but—

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What should I wear? I totally want to get 
Flight-chan's stylish seal of approval~

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Totally~. If I stick to something similar 
to the outfit that got praised last year, 
will that work? Or would it be better to 
go with what Flight-chan likes?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(...To think my very existence has ended 
up distorting the true essence of Droit 
Coordé...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Those kids sure were fired up... Maybe I 
should just leave them be, as their own 
way of enjoying things...?)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(—No. Trainer told me that it's okay to be 
stubborn about the things that 
matter—so...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It might pour cold water on everyone, and 
it might just be selfish... but still.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A Droite coord isn't worn to seek someone 
else's approval. It is for oneself, and 
for one's date—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I want her to remember... that fashion is 
something that brings out your natural 
charm and lets you shine bright...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just knew you'd say that, 
Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For now, before the Droite, I'm thinking 
of holding a styling consultation session 
for our Droite outfits.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So I hope I can remind everyone once again 
how important the feelings behind an 
outfit truly are.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! What magnificent spirit! I shall 
assist you with all my heart and soul!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As the Class Rep, I shall enlighten 
everyone about the magnificence of the 
Droite style!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Droite coords, some girls 
struggle to decide what's best, or get 
totally overwhelmed, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The answer is surprisingly simple: what 
feelings do you want to convey, and what 
do you want to express? Let's start by 
thinking about that.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Feelings kept secret, feelings meant to be 
shared, feelings meant to connect between 
the two—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I also heaped on a mega-serving of my 
own passion and feelings for Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Chasing speed, competing, lifting each 
other higher, forever and anywhere――!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is a one-of-a-kind Bakushin outfit 
that only we could create!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan... ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to pour my own aspiration into it 
too. A brilliance that only the two of us 
can wear.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Sparkling like an aurora, our unfading 
moment—!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I believe Droite coords are the physical 
manifestation of the feelings each and 
every one of us wears.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
On the special runway that is Droite, we 
can express our feelings with our very own 
bodies—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
An outfit tailored just for you, that only 
you can pull off, is uniquely wonderful ♪

text_block_list.name: Consulting Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...My own feelings, huh? Maybe I hadn't 
given that any thought at all..."

text_block_list.name: Consulting Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should talk it over with my date 
one more time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Everyone was listening with such 
deep admiration! As expected of our 
fashion leader, Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No. It wasn't just my doing. Bakushin 
O-chan helped out too, and—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Besides... there was someone who accepted 
my selfish obsession and gave me the push 
I needed.

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Flight-chan...! Could you maybe... check 
my outfit?

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It might not be what's in style... but I 
poured all of my own feelings into it!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(This girl... back then, she was trying to 
pick an outfit with my appraisal in 
mind——)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...It's absolutely wonderful! It's the 
best outfit ever, filled with your 
personality and your excitement for the 
date♪

“I want to dance with you after the 
soirée.” —Honoring that wish, I waited for 
North Flight in the best-coordinated 
outfit I could manage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, marvelous! Every single outfit is 
packed with passionate spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let Flight-san outdo me either! 
It's time for a Bakushin fashion check!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Over there, lovely floral patterns 
Bakushin! Over that way, a fiery red dress 
Bakushins! Hmm, everyone is Bakushin-ing!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. Everyone looks so good 
in them♪

“I want to dance with you after the 
soirée.” —Honoring that wish, I waited for 
North Flight in the best-coordinated 
outfit I could manage.

text_block_list.name: Droite Participant A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, judges! Look at our ultimate outfit 
combo, look look~!

text_block_list.name: Droite Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Well? I borrowed some inspiration from 
Flight-chan and packed it full of my own 
style~!
choice_data_list:
（……I wonder if we'll be over capacity 
again this year?）

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who would like a fashion check, 
please line up over heーre!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
We've got plenty of fashionable judges 
this year, so take your time and don't 
rush~♪

“I want to dance with you after the 
soirée.” —Honoring that wish, I waited for 
North Flight in the best-coordinated 
outfit I could manage.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I've changed into my new outfit.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"My unyielding, unchanging dedication. You 
accepted it and gave me a push forward— I 
want to become a girl worthy of an adult 
like you."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I poured all my feelings into 
coordinating this outfit just for you."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...You too, Trainer. I can feel your 
feelings for me through your outfit.
choice_data_list:
It feels a bit plain compared to Flight, 
though...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Plain? Not at all! The warmth of your 
feelings shines so bright, it's almost 
blinding—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Your fashion check gets a gold star♪
